name: Home Assistant Connect ZBT-1

radios.note: Silicon Labs EFR32MG21, 2.4 GHz. Runs Zigbee or Thread firmware, not both at once; no Bluetooth or Z-Wave. Model NC-ZBT-9710.

matter.note: No CSA listing sought or found; the dongle is a radio, not a Matter device.

apple_home.note: Reachable only through Home Assistant software, which is not a hub; not confirmed.

google_home.note: Reachable only through Home Assistant software; not confirmed.

alexa.note: Reachable only through Home Assistant software; not confirmed.

home_assistant.note: Official Home Assistant hardware: Zigbee through ZHA, Thread through the OpenThread Border Router app.

hubRequired.note: It is not standalone: it needs Home Assistant running on a host such as Home Assistant Green.

localControl.note: A USB radio driven by the Home Assistant host; no official page cited here states local control in so many words.

hubType.note: Formerly Home Assistant SkyConnect; same hardware.

deviceProtocols.note: One at a time: the Thread firmware is Thread-only, so Zigbee devices stop working while it runs.

matterBridge.note: Not a bridge; Matter devices on Thread are reached through Home Assistant's Matter integration.

threadBorderRouter.note: With Thread firmware and the OpenThread Border Router app.

summary: Placeholder summary pending the editor: this record lists what the hub connects to and which ecosystems see those devices. USB radio stick for Home Assistant, Zigbee or Thread, one at a time.
